Job Description: **Cubicle Fugitive is looking for a rare kind of designer.**

  

Someone with an exceptional eye who is equally happy building a brand from scratch and honouring one that already exists. Brand and website design are the heart of what we do, so you need real, demonstrable experience in both. You’ll create logos and brand systems, design and shape corporate websites, and produce collateral, advertising, and campaigns for clients who do serious, expert work. You’ll also help look after the design and production for the many brands we manage every day.

  

Most of our clients are professional services firms. The work leans corporate, considered, and clean, and it exists to do a job: position each firm clearly and help them win and keep the right clients. If you love smart, disciplined design and take pride in getting the details right, you’ll fit well here.

 ***This is a full\-time, permanent role on a hybrid schedule, based out of our office in Hamilton, Ontario.***

 **What You’ll Do**


* **Create across mediums.** Build brands from the ground up: logos, visual identities, and the collateral that brings them to life. Design and refine corporate websites. Develop campaigns across digital, social, and video, plus the everyday templates clients rely on (PowerPoint, Word, email, paid and organic social).
* **Honour, roll out, and protect existing brands.** Much of the work is production inside established brand systems: rolling out approved visuals across collateral, decks, social, and websites, keeping every brand consistent, and improving it without losing what makes it theirs. We manage close to 80 brands, so this matters as much as net\-new creative.
* **Start with the client, and the result.** Understand what each client actually needs before you design, and connect your choices to their audience, their goals, and the business outcome they are paying for. We care about work that performs and positions the firm, not only work that looks good.
* **Pitch and present.** Explain your thinking clearly, in writing and out loud, so clients and colleagues understand why a design decision is the right one.
* **Use AI to work faster and better.** We want designers who use AI to take the grind out of repetitive production, to produce layouts, wireframes, and mockups quickly so the team and the client can react to real options early, and to make work that once needed a much bigger budget. The specific tools change constantly. Good judgment in using them does not.
* **Manage the work.** Move between multiple projects, stakeholders, and approvals without dropping quality. Work to time and budget, ask sharp questions, and stay productive even when the brief is incomplete.
* **Stay current.** Track where design, web, video, and AI are heading, test new approaches, and share what you learn with the team.

  


**What You Bring**



Essential


* **An excellent portfolio.** This is the first thing we look at and the thing that matters most. We want to see range across brand and web, a clear rationale behind your choices, and real skill at making complex things simple.
* **Brand and website design experience, both.** Brand and web make up most of our work, so you need a real track record designing brand identities and designing or shaping user\-friendly websites. No coding required, though an understanding of UI/UX and what is buildable helps a great deal.
* **Around four or more years in a design role.** Strong, experienced candidates will be considered for more senior roles. Formal design training helps, but a great portfolio and practical experience matter more to us than a specific degree.
* **Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.** Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, and the rest, with genuine comfort working inside brand guidelines as well as creating them.
* **Care and ownership.** You keep your promises, seek clarity early, and care about outcomes as much as outputs.
* **Curiosity, resourcefulness, and easy collaboration.** You experiment, find practical solutions, and give and take feedback without the noise.

  



Considered a strong asset


* **Agency experience.** A big advantage. Agency people understand how to do excellent work inside real time, budget, and client constraints, and how to hold quality high when none of those are generous.
* **Professional\-services or corporate brand experience** (law, accounting, engineering, healthcare, and the like).
* **A talent for the big campaign idea,** and for brand headlines and copy.
* **Video production and editing, motion graphics, or photography.**

  


**Tools You’ll Use**


* **Design and motion:** Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, After Effects (Premiere Pro is a plus)
* **Web and UI/UX:** Figma, with a real understanding of components, prototypes, and responsive design
* **Templates and content:** PowerPoint and Word template design; Canva for social systems
* **Email and marketing:** Mailchimp, Campaign Monitor, or HubSpot for branded templates
* **AI:** we are deliberately tool\-agnostic here. The tools change too fast to list, so what matters is using them well to speed up production and exploration.
* **Good habits:** clean file organization, sensible versioning, and tidy handoffs (we use Accelo and Dropbox)

  


**How We Work**



We value our designers, and we protect a studio that stays honest and flat. Everyone here has a voice and we expect you to use yours. Strong opinions and good arguments are welcome. Big egos are not. The aim is never to win the room, it’s to deliver the best result for the client, and the best idea wins no matter who it comes from.

 **About Us**



Cubicle Fugitive is a full\-service brand, marketing, and web agency. We provide high\-calibre work to companies large and small, mostly in professional services, with clients in education, construction, and healthcare. We help people who do excellent work get noticed by the people who need them, and we look after their brand across every touchpoint.

  

The day\-to\-day is friendly and flexible, with good people and competitive pay. There is a healthcare spending account and an EAP, team events you will probably enjoy (escape rooms feature heavily), an on\-site gym we admire more than we use, and a group chat with more memes and board game talk than anyone asked for.


**Equal Opportunity**



We are an equal\-opportunity employer, and we think the best work comes from a team of different backgrounds and perspectives. We welcome applicants of every race, culture, gender, age, orientation, belief, and background, and we want a workplace where you belong and are heard.


**How to Apply**



Share your portfolio (essential), your résumé, and a short note about yourself. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, just let us know.

Job Description: **About Us**

6E Intercultural Education is a tutoring center dedicated to helping students learn and grow with confidence. Throughout the year, we host family and seasonal events, and we're looking for a talented balloon artist to bring colour, energy, and fun to these events — and keep our youngest guests smiling.

**The Role**

As our event balloon artist, you'll create balloon animals, sculptures, and custom designs that delight children and families at our in\-center and community events. You'll be one of the friendly, high\-energy faces that make our events feel welcoming and memorable.

**What You'll Do**

\- Create balloon animals, hats, flowers, swords, and custom designs on request

\- Engage warmly with children and families and keep the atmosphere lively

\- Set up and pack down your station at each event

\- Work safely and attentively around young children, following our event guidelines

**What We're Looking For**

\- Demonstrated experience in balloon twisting or balloon art

\- Great with kids — patient, friendly, and energetic

\- Reliable and punctual for scheduled events

\- Able to stand and work for the length of an event

**Nice to Have**

\- Availability on weekends and during school holidays

\- Your own balloons and supplies, and your own transportation

Please have photos or a portfolio of your balloon art ready to share, as we'd love to see your work.

Pay: $17\.65\-$21\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* On\-site parking

Job Description: **Cubicle Fugitive is looking for a rare kind of designer.**

  

Someone with an exceptional eye who is equally happy building a brand from scratch and honouring one that already exists. Brand and website design are the heart of what we do, so you need real, demonstrable experience in both. You’ll create logos and brand systems, design and shape corporate websites, and produce collateral, advertising, and campaigns for clients who do serious, expert work. You’ll also help look after the design and production for the many brands we manage every day.

  

Most of our clients are professional services firms. The work leans corporate, considered, and clean, and it exists to do a job: position each firm clearly and help them win and keep the right clients. If you love smart, disciplined design and take pride in getting the details right, you’ll fit well here.

 ***This is a full\-time, permanent role on a hybrid schedule, based out of our office in Hamilton, Ontario.***

 **What You’ll Do**


* **Create across mediums.** Build brands from the ground up: logos, visual identities, and the collateral that brings them to life. Design and refine corporate websites. Develop campaigns across digital, social, and video, plus the everyday templates clients rely on (PowerPoint, Word, email, paid and organic social).
* **Honour, roll out, and protect existing brands.** Much of the work is production inside established brand systems: rolling out approved visuals across collateral, decks, social, and websites, keeping every brand consistent, and improving it without losing what makes it theirs. We manage close to 80 brands, so this matters as much as net\-new creative.
* **Start with the client, and the result.** Understand what each client actually needs before you design, and connect your choices to their audience, their goals, and the business outcome they are paying for. We care about work that performs and positions the firm, not only work that looks good.
* **Pitch and present.** Explain your thinking clearly, in writing and out loud, so clients and colleagues understand why a design decision is the right one.
* **Use AI to work faster and better.** We want designers who use AI to take the grind out of repetitive production, to produce layouts, wireframes, and mockups quickly so the team and the client can react to real options early, and to make work that once needed a much bigger budget. The specific tools change constantly. Good judgment in using them does not.
* **Manage the work.** Move between multiple projects, stakeholders, and approvals without dropping quality. Work to time and budget, ask sharp questions, and stay productive even when the brief is incomplete.
* **Stay current.** Track where design, web, video, and AI are heading, test new approaches, and share what you learn with the team.

  


**What You Bring**



Essential


* **An excellent portfolio.** This is the first thing we look at and the thing that matters most. We want to see range across brand and web, a clear rationale behind your choices, and real skill at making complex things simple.
* **Brand and website design experience, both.** Brand and web make up most of our work, so you need a real track record designing brand identities and designing or shaping user\-friendly websites. No coding required, though an understanding of UI/UX and what is buildable helps a great deal.
* **Around four or more years in a design role.** Strong, experienced candidates will be considered for more senior roles. Formal design training helps, but a great portfolio and practical experience matter more to us than a specific degree.
* **Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.** Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, and the rest, with genuine comfort working inside brand guidelines as well as creating them.
* **Care and ownership.** You keep your promises, seek clarity early, and care about outcomes as much as outputs.
* **Curiosity, resourcefulness, and easy collaboration.** You experiment, find practical solutions, and give and take feedback without the noise.

  



Considered a strong asset


* **Agency experience.** A big advantage. Agency people understand how to do excellent work inside real time, budget, and client constraints, and how to hold quality high when none of those are generous.
* **Professional\-services or corporate brand experience** (law, accounting, engineering, healthcare, and the like).
* **A talent for the big campaign idea,** and for brand headlines and copy.
* **Video production and editing, motion graphics, or photography.**

  


**Tools You’ll Use**


* **Design and motion:** Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, After Effects (Premiere Pro is a plus)
* **Web and UI/UX:** Figma, with a real understanding of components, prototypes, and responsive design
* **Templates and content:** PowerPoint and Word template design; Canva for social systems
* **Email and marketing:** Mailchimp, Campaign Monitor, or HubSpot for branded templates
* **AI:** we are deliberately tool\-agnostic here. The tools change too fast to list, so what matters is using them well to speed up production and exploration.
* **Good habits:** clean file organization, sensible versioning, and tidy handoffs (we use Accelo and Dropbox)

  


**How We Work**



We value our designers, and we protect a studio that stays honest and flat. Everyone here has a voice and we expect you to use yours. Strong opinions and good arguments are welcome. Big egos are not. The aim is never to win the room, it’s to deliver the best result for the client, and the best idea wins no matter who it comes from.

 **About Us**



Cubicle Fugitive is a full\-service brand, marketing, and web agency. We provide high\-calibre work to companies large and small, mostly in professional services, with clients in education, construction, and healthcare. We help people who do excellent work get noticed by the people who need them, and we look after their brand across every touchpoint.

  

The day\-to\-day is friendly and flexible, with good people and competitive pay. There is a healthcare spending account and an EAP, team events you will probably enjoy (escape rooms feature heavily), an on\-site gym we admire more than we use, and a group chat with more memes and board game talk than anyone asked for.


**Equal Opportunity**



We are an equal\-opportunity employer, and we think the best work comes from a team of different backgrounds and perspectives. We welcome applicants of every race, culture, gender, age, orientation, belief, and background, and we want a workplace where you belong and are heard.


**How to Apply**



Share your portfolio (essential), your résumé, and a short note about yourself. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, just let us know.

 ***This is a full\-time, permanent role on a hybrid schedule, based out of our office in Hamilton, Ontario.***

 **What You’ll Do**


* **Create across mediums.** Build brands from the ground up: logos, visual identities, and the collateral that brings them to life. Design and refine corporate websites. * **Use AI to work faster and better.** We want designers who use AI to take the grind out of repetitive production, to produce layouts, wireframes, and mockups quickly so the team and the client can react to real options early, and to make work that once needed a much bigger budget. * **Manage the work.** Move between multiple projects, stakeholders, and approvals without dropping quality. Work to time and budget, ask sharp questions, and stay productive even when the brief is incomplete.

Job Description: **Cubicle Fugitive is looking for a rare kind of designer.**

  

Someone with an exceptional eye who is equally happy building a brand from scratch and honouring one that already exists. Brand and website design are the heart of what we do, so you need real, demonstrable experience in both. You’ll create logos and brand systems, design and shape corporate websites, and produce collateral, advertising, and campaigns for clients who do serious, expert work. You’ll also help look after the design and production for the many brands we manage every day.

  

Most of our clients are professional services firms. The work leans corporate, considered, and clean, and it exists to do a job: position each firm clearly and help them win and keep the right clients. If you love smart, disciplined design and take pride in getting the details right, you’ll fit well here.

 ***This is a full\-time, permanent role on a hybrid schedule, based out of our office in Hamilton, Ontario.***

 **What You’ll Do**


* **Create across mediums.** Build brands from the ground up: logos, visual identities, and the collateral that brings them to life. Design and refine corporate websites. Develop campaigns across digital, social, and video, plus the everyday templates clients rely on (PowerPoint, Word, email, paid and organic social).
* **Honour, roll out, and protect existing brands.** Much of the work is production inside established brand systems: rolling out approved visuals across collateral, decks, social, and websites, keeping every brand consistent, and improving it without losing what makes it theirs. We manage close to 80 brands, so this matters as much as net\-new creative.
* **Start with the client, and the result.** Understand what each client actually needs before you design, and connect your choices to their audience, their goals, and the business outcome they are paying for. We care about work that performs and positions the firm, not only work that looks good.
* **Pitch and present.** Explain your thinking clearly, in writing and out loud, so clients and colleagues understand why a design decision is the right one.
* **Use AI to work faster and better.** We want designers who use AI to take the grind out of repetitive production, to produce layouts, wireframes, and mockups quickly so the team and the client can react to real options early, and to make work that once needed a much bigger budget. The specific tools change constantly. Good judgment in using them does not.
* **Manage the work.** Move between multiple projects, stakeholders, and approvals without dropping quality. Work to time and budget, ask sharp questions, and stay productive even when the brief is incomplete.
* **Stay current.** Track where design, web, video, and AI are heading, test new approaches, and share what you learn with the team.

  


**What You Bring**



Essential


* **An excellent portfolio.** This is the first thing we look at and the thing that matters most. We want to see range across brand and web, a clear rationale behind your choices, and real skill at making complex things simple.
* **Brand and website design experience, both.** Brand and web make up most of our work, so you need a real track record designing brand identities and designing or shaping user\-friendly websites. No coding required, though an understanding of UI/UX and what is buildable helps a great deal.
* **Around four or more years in a design role.** Strong, experienced candidates will be considered for more senior roles. Formal design training helps, but a great portfolio and practical experience matter more to us than a specific degree.
* **Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.** Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, and the rest, with genuine comfort working inside brand guidelines as well as creating them.
* **Care and ownership.** You keep your promises, seek clarity early, and care about outcomes as much as outputs.
* **Curiosity, resourcefulness, and easy collaboration.** You experiment, find practical solutions, and give and take feedback without the noise.

  



Considered a strong asset


* **Agency experience.** A big advantage. Agency people understand how to do excellent work inside real time, budget, and client constraints, and how to hold quality high when none of those are generous.
* **Professional\-services or corporate brand experience** (law, accounting, engineering, healthcare, and the like).
* **A talent for the big campaign idea,** and for brand headlines and copy.
* **Video production and editing, motion graphics, or photography.**

  


**Tools You’ll Use**


* **Design and motion:** Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, After Effects (Premiere Pro is a plus)
* **Web and UI/UX:** Figma, with a real understanding of components, prototypes, and responsive design
* **Templates and content:** PowerPoint and Word template design; Canva for social systems
* **Email and marketing:** Mailchimp, Campaign Monitor, or HubSpot for branded templates
* **AI:** we are deliberately tool\-agnostic here. The tools change too fast to list, so what matters is using them well to speed up production and exploration.
* **Good habits:** clean file organization, sensible versioning, and tidy handoffs (we use Accelo and Dropbox)

  


**How We Work**



We value our designers, and we protect a studio that stays honest and flat. Everyone here has a voice and we expect you to use yours. Strong opinions and good arguments are welcome. Big egos are not. The aim is never to win the room, it’s to deliver the best result for the client, and the best idea wins no matter who it comes from.

 **About Us**



Cubicle Fugitive is a full\-service brand, marketing, and web agency. We provide high\-calibre work to companies large and small, mostly in professional services, with clients in education, construction, and healthcare. We help people who do excellent work get noticed by the people who need them, and we look after their brand across every touchpoint.

  

The day\-to\-day is friendly and flexible, with good people and competitive pay. There is a healthcare spending account and an EAP, team events you will probably enjoy (escape rooms feature heavily), an on\-site gym we admire more than we use, and a group chat with more memes and board game talk than anyone asked for.


**Equal Opportunity**



We are an equal\-opportunity employer, and we think the best work comes from a team of different backgrounds and perspectives. We welcome applicants of every race, culture, gender, age, orientation, belief, and background, and we want a workplace where you belong and are heard.


**How to Apply**



Share your portfolio (essential), your résumé, and a short note about yourself. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, just let us know.

If you take pride in producing high\-quality work, maintaining production speed, and working as part of a reliable team, we’d love to hear from you.

**Responsibilities:**

Set up and operate automatic screen printing presses.

Register jobs accurately and maintain print quality throughout production.

Mix inks and prepare screens when required.

Monitor print quality and make adjustments as needed.

Meet daily production targets while maintaining attention to detail.

Keep equipment and work area clean and organized.

Work closely with the production team to ensure orders are completed on schedule.

**Qualifications:**

Previous screen printing experience is required.

Experience operating automatic presses is an asset.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Ability to work in a fast\-paced production environment.

Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently.

Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

**What We Offer:**

Starting wage of $20–$25 per hour, depending on experience.

Full\-time, stable employment.

Modern equipment and a clean production facility.

Opportunity for growth within the company.

If you’re an experienced screen printer looking to join a growing team, we’d love to hear from you. Apply through Indeed with your resume.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $20\.00\-$25\.00 per hour

* Screen Printing: 1 year (required)

Work Location: In person
